Figure 2:Overview of PREEN. Given a content imageXXand a style referenceYY, PREEN predicts a2929-parameter editor presetPpredP_{\mathrm{pred}}in a single forward pass. ApplyingPpredP_{\mathrm{pred}}with our differentiable editorEEyieldsXpred′X^{\prime}_{\mathrm{pred}}; the strength knobα\alphascales the preset’s chroma parameters before editing. PREEN’s output is a compact, human-editable preset rather than a rendered image. Flame icons mark the modules updated during training (CLIP only through low-rank adapters), and the snowflake marks the fixed editor.
